# Test cross-compiling a cgo-binding binary to aix/ppc64.

[short] skip

# Cross-compiling a cgo-binding binary to aix/ppc64 without a working AIX C
# toolchain produces a clear error, while a working CC cross-compiler links.
cd aixbind
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
env GOOS=aix
env GOARCH=ppc64
env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
# On an AIX host, the default CC is a working AIX toolchain.
[!GOOS:aix] env CC=
[!GOOS:aix] ! go build -o $devnull .
[!GOOS:aix] stderr 'cgo bindings on aix/ppc64 require an external linker'
env CC=$WORK${/}nonexistent
! go build -o $devnull .
stderr 'cgo bindings on aix/ppc64 require an external linker'
[GOOS:windows] stop
[!exec:sh] stop
chmod 0755 $WORK/gopath/src/fake-aix-cc.sh
env CC=$WORK/gopath/src/fake-aix-cc.sh
go build -o $WORK/aix.exe .
exists $WORK/aix.exe

-- fake-aix-cc.sh --
#!/bin/sh
for arg in "$@"; do
	case "$arg" in
	-Wl,-V)
		echo "/usr/bin/ld: LD 7.2.2(1/1/19)"
		echo "ld: 0711-317 ERROR: Undefined symbol: .main"
		exit 1
		;;
	--print-file-name=*)
		echo "/lib/${arg#--print-file-name=}"
		exit 0
		;;
	esac
done
prev=""
for arg in "$@"; do
	if [ "$prev" = "-o" ]; then : > "$arg"; exit 0; fi
	prev="$arg"
done
exit 0

-- aixbind/go.mod --
module aixbind

go 1.28

-- aixbind/main.go --
package main

import "C"

//cgo:func puts puts libc
func puts(s *byte) int32

func main() {
	puts(nil)
}
